_comment: M10 PR 2's first commit (SPEC/10 section 2 'The call record'; R2 door 2 hybrid, R5): one object as the door's delivery writes it under calls/agents/festival-desk/ in the audit bucket, holding the API's access-log lines for the four calls that pass the door's front: the platform's own goldens call, the admitted user, no token, and a stranger's token. Each line is in the format the construct's stage writes (infra/construct/governed_agent.py, ACCESS_LOG_FORMAT), with API Gateway's '-' where a value is absent: a call with no token is refused by the API before any authoriser runs, so its line names no subject and carries the API's own error. This shape is the construct's, written here before any door is deployed; the first live object, read by PR 3's run, is what shows it (SPEC/10 section 7, the risks). The bypass call does not pass the door and has no line here: its record is the data event beside this file. Times are made up; the pool ids, request ids and the address are placeholders. A fixture, never evidence.
